resources.string: The amount of electric current flowing into or out of the battery. Positive values indicate charging, while negative values indicate the device is using battery power.
The electrical pressure provided by the battery. A typical smartphone battery operates between 3.2V (empty) and 4.4V (full).
The current temperature of the battery. Keeping your battery cool (below 35°C / 95°F) helps prolong its total lifespan.
The current amount of energy stored in the battery as a percentage of its estimated full capacity.
The estimated total energy capacity of your battery. This value is calculated by comparing the current charge counter with the percentage level.
The system\'s report on the physical condition of the battery. Most devices report \'Good\' unless there is a hardware failure or significant degradation.
The chemical technology used in the battery. Most modern smartphones use Lithium-ion (Li-ion) or Lithium-polymer (Li-poly) cells.
The source of power currently connected to the device. \'Battery\' means the device is not plugged in.
